features.name: Map browsing
steps: Open Google Maps
Show the default map area
Drag the canvas to pan the map in different directions
Zoom the map with + / -
Roads, city and area names, and POIs re-render as the viewport changes
The current map center and zoom level stay consistent
features.expected: After panning and zooming the map features must re-render with the viewport; the current center and zoom level stay consistent.

features.name: Map localization / reset view
steps: Pan and zoom to other areas
Tap the map locate/re-center control
The map moves to the preset current location or a benchmark-specified location
Pan the map again
The located state updates correctly
features.expected: The locate control must move the map back to the preset position; after panning again the located state updates correctly.

features.name: Place search
steps: Enter a place name such as Los Angeles in the search box at the top
View the matching results
Select the target place
The map automatically moves and zooms to that place
Show the map Markers and the place-detail panel on the left
Modify the search term and run the search again
features.expected: Search results must match the keyword; after selecting a place the map moves and zooms to it and shows the Marker and detail panel; after modifying the search term the re-run is correct.

features.name: Merchant search
steps: Search for merchants already in the benchmark dataset, such as restaurants, supermarkets, or hotels
Show matching merchants and map markers
Open a merchant
View structured information such as the name, category, address, business hours, phone, and website
After returning to the search results the original search conditions are preserved
features.expected: Merchant search results correspond to the map markers; the details must show the name/category/address/business hours/phone/website; after returning the search conditions are preserved.

features.name: Quick category search
steps: Open the map
Tap the category entries at the top such as restaurants / hotels / recommended activities / museums / public transport
Retrieve the corresponding POIs for the current map area
The map generates category Markers
The result list corresponds to the map positions
After switching to another category the results are regenerated
features.expected: The category search must retrieve based on the current map area; the result list corresponds to the map Markers; after switching the category the results are regenerated.

features.name: Nearby search
steps: First search and open a place
Tap Nearby
Enter or select a category such as restaurants / hotels / bars
Search for nearby POIs centered on the current location
The map shows nearby Markers
Open one of the results
After returning the nearby search range is still preserved
features.expected: The nearby search must be centered on the current location; the surrounding Markers are displayed correctly; after returning the nearby search range is preserved.

features.name: Place details linked with the map
steps: Open a search result
The place details are shown on the left
The map highlights the corresponding Marker in sync
Switch to another place in the results list
The detail panel, Marker, and map center switch in sync
Closing the detail panel returns to the map view
features.expected: When switching results the detail panel / Marker / map center must switch in sync; closing the panel returns to the map view.

features.name: Driving route
steps: Open the routing feature
Set the start and end points
Choose driving
Compute one main route and several alternative routes
Each route shows the distance and estimated time
Choose a different route in the route list
The highlighted route on the map switches in sync
features.expected: The driving route must provide a main route and alternative routes; each shows the distance and time; after choosing a different route the map highlight switches in sync.

features.name: Transport-mode switching
steps: Create the start and end points
Switch between driving / public transport / walking / cycling
Regenerate the route, distance, and estimated time for each mode
Keep the start and end points unchanged
After switching back to the original mode the corresponding route is restored
features.expected: The four transport modes must each generate correct routes/distances/times; the start and end points stay unchanged; switching back to the original mode restores the corresponding route.

features.name: Multi-destination routes
steps: Create the start point and end point
Tap Add destination
Add a third place
The route is recomputed and passes several places in order
Modify one of the destinations
All routes, distances, and times are recomputed
After deleting the middle destination the two-point route is restored
features.expected: A multi-destination route must pass each point in order; after modifying a destination everything is recomputed; after deleting an intermediate point the two-point route is restored.

features.name: Alternative-route selection
steps: Produce a driving route
The map shows the main route and alternative routes at the same time
Tap another route on the map or a route card on the left
That route becomes the current main route
The time, distance, and highlight style update in sync
Then switch back to the original route
features.expected: Tapping an alternative route makes it the main route; the time/distance/highlight update in sync; it can be switched back to the original route.

features.name: Search along the route
steps: First create a driving route
Search for gas stations / hotels / EV charging stations along the route
Only matching POIs located near the route are returned
The map shows several result Markers along the route
Select a place from the results
That place can be used as a route stop
features.expected: The along-route search only returns matching POIs near the route; a result can be selected as a stop.

features.name: Along-route result filtering
steps: Perform a search along the route
Open the filter conditions
Filter by open now / open 24 hours / specific date and time
Apply conditions
The result list and map Markers decrease in sync
Clear the filters
Restore the complete result
features.expected: The along-route filters (open now / 24 hours / specific time) must reduce the results and Markers in sync; clearing them restores the full results.

features.name: Route time filtering
steps: Open the route
Use the "leave now" time option
Change to a benchmark-specified date or time
Recompute the route time information
After switching to another time the result updates again
The start and end points stay unchanged
features.expected: After the time filter changes the route time information is recomputed; the start and end points stay unchanged.

features.name: Recently visited
steps: Search and open several places in turn
Open Recent
Recently viewed places are shown by time
Tap one of the historical places
The map re-localizes and opens the details
The history record still exists when returning to the recent list
features.expected: Recently visited must be shown by time; tapping a historical place re-localizes the map; the history still exists after returning.

features.name: Save the place
steps: Open a place
Tap Save
Choose an existing list such as places to go / travel plans / starred places / favorite places
Open Saved
The target place appears in the corresponding list
Reopening the place shows the saved state
features.expected: After saving, the place must appear in the selected list; reopening the place shows the saved state.

features.name: Custom saved lists
steps: Open Saved
Tap New list
Create a list with a benchmark-specified name
Search for a place and save it to a new list
Return to the list page
The new list shows the corresponding place count
After deleting that place the list count updates
features.expected: After creating a list, saving places works correctly; the list shows the corresponding count; after deleting a place the count updates.

features.name: Toggle the saved state
steps: Open a saved place
View the one or more lists it belongs to
Remove one of the lists
The place remains in the other lists
After removing all lists the place returns to the unsaved state
features.expected: After removing one list the place remains in the other lists; after removing all it returns to the unsaved state.

features.name: Search linked with the map area
steps: Perform a category search in a certain area
Pan the map to another area
Search the current category again
The results are recomputed for the new map area
The Marker at the original area is replaced
The search category stays unchanged
features.expected: After panning the map, a new search must be computed over the new area; the previous Markers are replaced; the search category stays unchanged.

features.name: Swap the route's start and end points
steps: Create A
Route B
Tap the start/end swap button
Becomes B
A
The route is recomputed
The map's direction, distance, and estimated time update in sync
Swap again to restore the original route
features.expected: After swapping the start and end points the route is recomputed; the direction/distance/time update in sync; swapping again restores the original route.

exclusions.feature:
Street View
Enter road street view → 360° panorama movement → continuous road-level navigation
exclusions.reason: Requires large-scale panorama capture, road-to-panorama node matching, and proprietary imagery data; not suitable as a general agent-reproduction benchmark

exclusions.feature:
Live traffic
Show real-time congestion colors and dynamically change the route and ETA with current conditions
exclusions.reason: Depends on real-time vehicle and traffic data; free static OSM data cannot reproduce it reliably and benchmark results would change over time

exclusions.feature:
Live public transport
Real-time bus/subway arrival times, delays, and current vehicle positions
exclusions.reason: Depends on real-time city GTFS-RT or operator interfaces; coverage varies by city, which is not conducive to a unified benchmark

exclusions.feature:
Live route ETA
Dynamically predict the actual driving time from the day's traffic conditions
exclusions.reason: Requires real-time traffic and historical speed models; the benchmark should instead use fixed road weights and deterministic estimated times

exclusions.feature:
Street View user-photo navigation
360° user photos in place details, Photo Spheres, and continuous panorama jumps
exclusions.reason: Strongly depends on user-generated images and Google-hosted assets

exclusions.feature:
Google merchant reviews
Real ratings, review bodies, reviewer profiles, likes, etc.
exclusions.reason: Google Reviews data is not open data; the agent should not be required to scrape or copy it

exclusions.feature:
Google merchant photos
User-uploaded merchant photos, real place galleries, and photo author information
exclusions.reason: Image copyright and UGC data sources are unstable; the benchmark can provide only a few built-in placeholder images

exclusions.feature:
Real-time merchant busyness
Popular times / current busyness / typical visit duration
exclusions.reason: Depends on aggregated Google user location data, for which no reliable open substitute exists

exclusions.feature:
Live hotel prices and inventory
Hotel card prices, room types, availability, and supplier quotes
exclusions.reason: Depends on commercial APIs such as Booking/Expedia/hotels and real-time inventory; not part of the map's core capability

exclusions.feature:
Restaurant online booking / delivery / ordering
Complete reservations, orders, or purchases directly through the map
exclusions.reason: Depends on third-party transaction systems and payment/booking interfaces

exclusions.feature:
Gas-station live fuel prices
Show the current Regular/Premium price at a gas station
exclusions.reason: Real-time commercial data sources are unstable; fixed static prices can be used in test data, but real-time sync is not tested

exclusions.feature:
Real-time EV charger availability
E.g. 4 available out of 8
exclusions.reason: Requires charging-network operators' real-time APIs; the benchmark keeps only charging-station locations and static specifications; retained surface: f02 map localization / reset view, f04 merchant search, f17 custom saved lists

exclusions.feature:
User contributions
Your contributions / add a missing place / edit the map / suggest an edit / upload photos
exclusions.reason: Requires moderation, user identity, a backend database, and a community-governance system; not part of the core map-browsing experience

exclusions.feature:
Location sharing
Real-time sharing of the current location with other users and viewing others' locations
exclusions.reason: Requires multi-user accounts, real-time positioning, and a persistent connection, which exceeds a single-agent benchmark

exclusions.feature:
Timeline
Restore the places the user visited each day from historical GPS data
exclusions.reason: Strongly depends on real users' long-term location history and involves privacy and account data

exclusions.feature:
Google Maps history synced across devices
Search, browsing, and route history synced across multiple devices
exclusions.reason: Requires a Google account and cloud sync; the benchmark only requires the current local session or local persistence

exclusions.feature:
Send to phone
Push a place or route to the user's phone
exclusions.reason: Requires accounts, a mobile device, a push service, and cross-device communication

exclusions.feature:
Real share links / social sharing
Send map content to third-party apps or contacts
exclusions.reason: A local copy link can be implemented, but actually calling external social platforms is not required

exclusions.feature:
Print map / print route
Invoke the system print service and output a paper map
exclusions.reason: Weakly related to the map's core interactions and affected by the browser and OS print environment

exclusions.feature:
Google personalized recommendations
"Recommended for you", personalized restaurants, or places of interest generated from the user's history
exclusions.reason: Requires real long-term user behavior and a recommendation model; hard to guarantee benchmark repeatability

exclusions.feature:
Ads / Sponsored Places
Promoted merchants, ad ranking, and commercial recommendations in the map
exclusions.reason: Depends on the advertising system, bidding, and commercial data and should not enter the functional-reproduction score

exclusions.feature:
User account management
Google sign-in, avatar, account switching, privacy center, etc.
exclusions.reason: It belongs to the Google Account system rather than the core map features of Maps

exclusions.feature:
Offline maps / download areas
Download an area to a mobile device and use it without a network
exclusions.reason: A browser benchmark has no need to replicate the mobile offline-map infrastructure

exclusions.feature:
Google Earth / 3D Photorealistic models
Real city 3D buildings, oblique photography, and immersive views
exclusions.reason: Requires proprietary 3D Tiles, aerial photography, and massive rendering data, with development costs far exceeding the benchmark's value

exclusions.feature:
Immersive View
Simulate time, weather, and routes with a realistic 3D city
exclusions.reason: Depends on Google's proprietary imagery, 3D modeling, weather, and generative systems

exclusions.feature:
Live weather
Current temperature and weather state in the city card
exclusions.reason: It is an external real-time weather source and not a basic map feature; a fixed placeholder value can be used but it is not scored

exclusions.feature:
Complete global POI data parity
Requiring all real-world merchants, roads, and addresses to match Google Maps
exclusions.reason: Unrealistic and involving proprietary databases; the benchmark should limit itself to one fixed city/area and a fixed OSM data snapshot

exclusions.feature:
Pixel-perfect replication of Google's proprietary map styling
Road colors, label priorities, and building details identical to Google
exclusions.reason: Google map styles and data are not open resources; the interaction structure and features should be evaluated rather than requiring pixel-identical map tiles
